_comment: SURVEYED. The jeepney that carries people from the General Trias side straight through to SM
Dasmarinas / Pala-Pala without a transfer. It is genuinely missing from OpenStreetMap -- verified
2026-08-26 against the live database, where the only services boarding at Bella Vista are SM
Molino, Trece Martires, and the two BT Vista Mall runs.
Stop list confirmed 2026-08-28: Bella Vista, Vista Mall General Trias, Manggahan Junction, LPU
Cavite, Pala-Pala, SM City Dasmarinas. 'Waltermart Manggahan' as reported is not a named stop in
the database; Manggahan Junction is the existing stop nearest that boarding point and is what
this file uses. 'near' on the LPU Cavite entries only breaks a tie between two DB rows 108m
apart (the two kerbs of that stop) -- the app already merges them into one routing node at that
distance, so either resolves to the same place.
node scripts/push-custom-routes.ts --only gentri-dasma-jeepney --apply
Road geometry fetched 2026-08-28 from the public OSRM demo server (see
scripts/fetch-gentri-dasma-geometry.mjs), the same source and Ramer-Douglas-Peucker
simplification the pilot corridor's ROAD_PATHS table uses. Without 'waypoints' the map drew a
straight line stop to stop instead of following the road.
Re-fetched twice more the same day, QA report 'map detours toward Trece Martires':
Pass 2 dropped Manggahan Junction and LPU Cavite from the OSRM request entirely (kept as real
stops below, just not forced routing waypoints). That killed the big loop but left a smaller,
jagged one: both stops, plus two real unnamed OSM nodes on the road between them, all sit ~0.4-1.3km
off that 'direct' line, and the app's per-stop nearest-point projection onto a polyline that far
away produced an out-of-order zigzag rather than a clean detour.
Pass 3 (current) fetches per adjacent stop pair and concatenates, the same shape
scripts/fetch-roads.mjs already uses for the pilot corridor, rather than one multi-waypoint
request for the whole route. That was the actual fix: a direct Manggahan Junction -> LPU Cavite
query returns a clean 1.1km local road (monotonic, no loop) that the whole-route solver never
chose when asked to satisfy all six waypoints as one continuous through-trip. There IS still a
real ~1.3km westward jog to Manggahan Junction and LPU Cavite in the geometry -- that is not a
bug, it is the two stops' actual position relative to the Vista Mall-Pala-Pala corridor, confirmed
by the fact that skipping both entirely (pass 2) shortens the route by exactly that jog. Serving
them and drawing a straight line down the highway are mutually exclusive; this file serves them.
See scripts/fetch-gentri-dasma-geometry.mjs's header before changing this again.
name: Jeepney: General Trias to SM Dasmarinas via Pala-Pala
notes: Surveyed 2026-08-28. Single-seat ride connecting General Trias to SM Dasmarinas that OpenStreetMap does not map.
